cohort: 105 neonates classified as near miss cases and 209 controls admitted to hospitals in the Gurage zone, Southern Ethiopia
finding: History of abortion, referral from another healthcare institution, severe maternal morbidity during pregnancy, cesarean section delivery, and good essential newborn care knowledge were identified as determinants of neonatal near miss.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was associated with an increased risk of neonatal near miss.
